page_description: The emails your store sends: order confirmations and shipping updates to customers, new orders to staff, and staff account emails.
no_access_description: Ask the store owner for the notifications:read scope.
sender_log_title: Emails are only written to the server log
sender_log_description: Nothing reaches customers or staff yet. Whoever runs this deployment sets a sender (SMTP or Resend) and the from address under [email] in hypha.config.toml. Emails will go out from {from}.
branding_description: Every email shows these, through the email layout.
footer_description: Plain text under every email: your address, legal lines.
sender_description: The from address is the deployment's ({from}); the name goes with it.
recipients_description: Who gets the New order email. Up to {max} addresses.
order_link_description: The customer's order page, linked from their emails. '{order}' becomes the order's ID and '{token}' its access token, which lets the page show the order on any device. Blank: emails link to no order.
logo_description: A public image from the media library. It can't be deleted there while it's the logo.
templates_description: Each email starts from Hypha's default. Edit one to make it yours; reverting goes back to the default.
templates_group_buyer_description: Sent to the customer about their order.
templates_group_staff_description: Sent to your team: new orders, invites and password resets.
templates_group_layout_description: The frame every email is shown in.
template_broken_tooltip: {problem}. Emails use the default until it's fixed.
template_layout_description: The shared frame around every email: logo, colours and footer.
template_order_confirmation_description: Sent to the customer when they place an order.
template_order_shipped_description: Sent when you fulfil items and choose to notify the customer.
template_order_tracking_updated_descript: Sent when a shipment's tracking changes and you choose to notify.
template_order_cancelled_description: Sent when you cancel an order and choose to notify the customer.
template_staff_new_order_description: Sent to the staff recipients when an order is placed.
template_staff_invite_description: Sent to someone invited to the admin, with the link to join.
template_staff_password_reset_descriptio: Sent to a staff member who asked to reset their password.
template_customer_login_code_description: Sent to a customer signing in to the storefront, with their six-digit code.
template_customer_erasure_requested_desc: Sent to a customer who asked from their account to have their data erased, with the date it runs.
template_supplier_purchase_order_descrip: Sent to a supplier when you send them a purchase order.
editor_send_test_tooltip: Sends this preview to your own address.
editor_send_test_logged: Emails are only logged on this deployment: a test would reach nobody.
editor_broken_description: {problem}. Emails use the default until you fix and save it, or revert.
editor_layout_description: Messages fill its '{% block preheader %}' and '{% block content %}'. Saving checks every email against it, so a layout that breaks one isn't saved.
editor_subject_description: One line of Jinja, like Order '{{ order.number }}' confirmed.
editor_html_hint: Starts with '{% extends "layout" %}' and fills the layout's blocks.
editor_text_switch_description: Off: the plain-text version is made from the HTML.
preview_order_description: An order ID (ord_…) from the orders page; blank: a made-up order.
preview_last_working: Showing the last preview that worked.
preview_fix_problem: Fix the problem above to see a preview.
revert_dialog_description: Your changes to this template are deleted, and emails use Hypha's default from now on. Whether it's on stays as it is.
variables_description: Click one to copy it. Values are from a made-up order. A list's items are shown under [0]: loop over the list to print each.
variables_copy_failed: Couldn't copy: select the path and copy it yourself.
